summary: Unexpected scaling surcharge applied to dedicated reserved hours after autoscale warmup tasks tagged to tenant
description:
Issue summary: Customer reported an unexpected 'scaling-surcharge' charge on their finalized invoice for 2026-03-01 00:00-01:00 UTC. The charge corresponds to ~3 reserved GPU-hours that Veridian expected to be covered by their dedicated reservation. Impact: Customer sees a $1,250 line item labeled 'scaling-surcharge' and provisional negative balance that blocks autopay. Environment: Dedicated pool (veridian-prod-pool), prod/us-east-1, hourly billing window. Steps to reproduce / observed sequence:
1) Customer's dedicated pool autoscaled from 8->12 GPUs at 2026-03-01T00:07 during a scheduled warmup.
2) A set of asynchronous warmup jobs (internal tag: warmup-job, tenant tag: veridian-tenant) were executed and completed between 00:08-00:14.
3) Postback stream delivered usage records; postback ordering shows warmup postbacks arrived after hourly boundary reconciliation.
4) Finalized invoice shows scaling-surcharge line for 3 GPU-hours billed at on-demand uplift instead of consuming reserved hours. Expected behavior: Warmup tasks from dedicated pool should consume reserved capacity and be billed at the dedicated reserved rate, not the scaling/on-demand surcharge. Actual behavior: Three warmup hours attributed to on-demand/scale-surcharge due to rate-ladder recalculation at hour boundary after out-of-order postbacks. Logs/attachments: customer provided invoice PDF, warmup job IDs, and postback timestamps (attached).
comments: 2026-03-13 09:12 - Leah Gomez (Support): Initial ticket created after phone call with Veridian billing ops. Customer supplied invoice lines and warmup-job IDs. Requested an audit of the hour in question and provisional hold on autopay.

2026-03-13 10:02 - Ethan Murphy (Billing SME): I am triaging. Noted that the reservation capacity shows 0 slack at 00:00-01:00. Requesting postback batches for 00:00-00:20 and the rate-ladder snapshot at 00:00 UTC.

2026-03-13 11:25 - SRE (Ana Ruiz): Pulled postback ordering from kafka partition 12. Observed 3 warmup postbacks with produced_at 00:12:02 but consumed/acked 00:01:10 due to retry window; ordering index suggests they were reconciled after hourly aggregator ran. Possible race between hour-finalize job and late postbacks.

2026-03-13 13:08 - Billing eng (Marco Silva): Rate-ladder recalculation at 00:00 uses committed reservations snapshot. If late postbacks are applied after finalization, they should be backfilled into reserved bucket. Investigating aggregator idempotency and late-postback handling path.

2026-03-14 08:41 - Customer (Veridian Billing Ops - Jenna S.): Customer requests temporary credit for the $1,250 while engineering investigates; also wants confirmation that future warmup runs won't be billed at on-demand rates.

2026-03-14 12:05 - Ethan Murphy (Support): Created linked INT for internal aggregator patch. Noted plan to issue provisional credit and to rollfix the reconciler. Awaiting confirmation from Billing eng on credit amount and permanent mitigation timeline.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis: Late postbacks and out-of-order delivery caused the hourly finalizer to mark the 3 warmup-hours as overflow/on-demand. Two contributing factors spotted: (1) autoscale-created warmup jobs are tagged 'warmup-job' and routed to async runner which posts back to a different partition causing replay ordering; (2) hourly aggregator (hourly-reconciler v2) finalizes rate-ladder then applies late-postbacks as separate 'overflow' items instead of reassigning into reserved bucket. Evidence: kafka offsets and aggregator logs show late_postback_handler invoked with 'overflow' flag at 00:05 and invoice generator accepted overflow lines. Repro: Simulated warmup jobs in staging with delayed postback show same surcharge behavior when postback arrives after aggregator finalization. Preliminary fix: Mark late postbacks with tenant reservation_id and trigger aggregator re-evaluation for the affected hour before finalization or apply retroactive backfill. Follow-up work: Introduce dedupe/backfill path in hourly-reconciler and ensure warmup jobs postback to main partition to avoid reorder. Related internal PR: INT-1289 references aggregator backfill prototype.
requested_outcome:
1) Refund or provisional credit for the $1,250 scaling-surcharge charged to Veridian for 2026-03-01 hour.
2) Code fix or compensating process to backfill late postbacks into reserved buckets so future warmup tasks are not billed at on-demand rates.
3) Confirmation note to customer and a short runbook describing warmup tagging best practices.
resolution: Pending - provisional credit requested from Billing team. Engineering to provide patch ETA.
